name: biorez-s2
description: BioRez S2 — Scientific Multi-Signal Frequency Control & Analysis Platform — Cyberpunk Edel Edition

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js 2>&1 || (echo '--- fallback legacy runner ---' && for f in tests/*.test.js; do echo "RUN $f"; node "$f"; done)
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit.test.js && node tests/calibration.test.js && node tests/comparison.test.js && node tests/fft.test.js && node tests/preset.test.js && node tests/security.test.js && node tests/storage.test.js && node tests/pdf.test.js && node tests/premium.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:backend && npm run test:hardware && npm run test:stress
scripts.lint: node_modules/.bin/eslint core/ analysis/ hardware/ frontend/js/ backend/ plugins/ || npx eslint@8 core/ analysis/ hardware/ frontend/js/ backend/ plugins/ --ext .js || echo 'eslint not installed, skipping'
scripts.lint:fix: node_modules/.bin/eslint core/ analysis/ hardware/ frontend/js/ backend/ plugins/ --fix || npx eslint@8 core/ analysis/ hardware/ frontend/js/ backend/ plugins/ --ext .js --fix
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: echo 'No build step needed — vanilla ESM + Canvas, ready for Vite if needed' && npm run test:all

author: BioRez S2 Team
